observation_contract.endpoint_convention: include t=0 and t=T when T*fs is integer
observation_contract.compatible_set: Within the prospectively named finite candidate subset for a contrast, two members are observation-compatible iff every declared observed array on the declared schedule agrees under the observed-array numerical criterion. Hidden descriptors cannot enter membership.

cases.RATE_PROJECTION: same NORMAL continuous truth and declared C/x0 projected on HZ96/HZ48/HZ24

units_and_metric.benchmark_state: all q and v coordinates are dimensionless canonical benchmark coordinates; time is seconds
units_and_metric.metric: G is symmetric positive definite; base benchmark G=I; transformed G'=S^-T G S^-1
units_and_metric.peak_direction: return G-normalized physical direction; if singular value is degenerate return the dominant right-singular projector/subspace mapped to physical coordinates

global_peak_certificate.target: supremum of physical-metric propagator gain over [0,32]
global_peak_certificate.production: validated interval branch-and-bound over time. Partition switching cases at every switch boundary. For each interval use a conservative Lipschitz upper bound derived from the frozen transformed generator norm and interval lower bound from evaluated points. Subdivide until every surviving interval's upper bound is within the numerical peak enclosure tolerance of the global lower bound.
global_peak_certificate.argmax: retain the union of all non-pruned time intervals whose upper bound remains within the frozen peak-tie criterion of the best lower bound
global_peak_certificate.reference: independent high-precision/dense route plus analytic anchors where available; production and reference disagreement blocks closure
global_peak_certificate.C04_separating_evidence: before execution, record a witness time with disjoint response-curve enclosures and disjoint certified enclosures for peak gain and integrated burden

switching_discrepancy.mean_operator: Abar is the period-time-weighted arithmetic mean of the exact two frozen segment A matrices
switching_discrepancy.switched: Phi(t,0) is the chronological right-continuous ordered propagator under the frozen phase and switching law
switching_discrepancy.curve: D(t)=||Phi(t,0)-Phi_bar(t)||_2 in the declared dimensionless benchmark metric
reported: full D(t) curve on the declared evaluation schedule

numerical_definitions.matrix_abs: entrywise max-absolute difference <=1e-12 in declared dimensionless operator units
numerical_definitions.spectrum_abs: minimum perfect matching of eigenvalue multisets under complex modulus <=1e-10 s^-1
numerical_definitions.peak_tie: candidate peak-gain enclosures overlap after expanding each by 1e-9*max(1,abs(gain))

contrast_clarifications.C05: B-dependent arrays are state_impulse exp(At)B and io_impulse C exp(At)B; spectral alpha is B-invariant
contrast_clarifications.C06: C-dependent arrays are observed_recovery C exp(At)x0 and io_impulse C exp(At)B; latent spectral alpha is C-invariant
contrast_clarifications.EQ_LOCAL_01: rename semantic label to EQUAL_DECLARED_LOCAL_MODAL_COORDINATES; it asserts only equality of declared local omega/zeta coordinates, not dynamic equivalence
contrast_clarifications.balance: Function/Limit count parity is not required; the suite is intentionally limit-rich and designed counts are not prevalence
